tex_content.label: assumptions
tex_content.html:
1. Singular times are discrete in $\Ar $, and nonsingular time-slices are compact $3$-manifolds.

  2. The flow is defined in $[0,\infty )$ and curvature is pinched toward positive.

  3. For some $r_0>0,C<\infty $, points with $R\ge r_0^{-2}$ have strong $(C,\epsilon )$-canonical neighborhoods, so

    \[ \left|\frac{\partial R}{\partial t}\right|<CR^2,\qquad |\nabla R|<CR^{3/2}. \]

Theorem
[Properties of the limit metric at a singular time]
